Omega_S_over_B.presentation: Omega_{S/B} is generated by du with relations dP = 0, dP_u = 0 reduced modulo (P, P_u)
Omega_S_over_B.on_Puu_open: At a simple double root r (P(r)=P_u(r)=0, P_uu(r) != 0), the Jacobian criterion in the u-direction is nondegenerate for the double-root equation; the relative Kähler differentials of the rank-1 quotient B[u]/(u-r) vanish
Omega_S_over_B.note: Vanishing of Omega on the P_uu-open is consistent with etale/rank-1 behaviour but MUST NOT be used alone to infer flatness or isomorphism (workorder T6.0 explicit prohibition)
